title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Blueberry Sour Raspberry
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kit Only Refresh your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K vape kit with the Blueberry Sour Raspberry Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. This flavour-packed refill option includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an 8ml refill container, both filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid in a sharp and tangy berry blend. Blueberry Sour Raspberry brings together the sweet, juicy flavour of Blueberry with the bright tang of Raspberry and a sour twist for extra bite. Syrupy-sweet, sharp, and with just the right amount of sour, it’s a bold pick for vapers who like their fruity flavours with a little more bite than most. Each pod and refill pack is designed exclusively for the Dojo Blast 10K device and offers up to 10,000 puffs (device total), powered by Vaporesso's dual mesh coil and COREX 2.0 technology. The transparent pod design makes it easy to track your e-liquid levels, while the Smart Liq-Cycle system ensures steady coil saturation for consistently excellent flavour. Explore all 28 flavours from the Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K collection here at Vapestore.
